operating_point.platform: CPU (laptop for development; GitHub's 4-vCPU runners for the gates' rates)
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: a parent diameter D of 1 mm; D/h 8 and 16 (h the grid's spacing); points on a world-aligned lattice of spacing h with a uniform sub-cell offset, within 1.3 D of the junction; the band |plain minimum| < 2h or |brute force| < 2h (the first step's band); the Y with equal radii D/2 (the spike's, segments 3 D) and with radii 0.5, 0.4, 0.3 D (segments 2 D), daughters at +-30 degrees
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: each draw a uniform random rotation of the vessel (never aligned with the lattice) and a uniform sub-cell offset, from DETECTION_SEED (fixed seeds in CI); 200 draws for each control's rate, fanned out as probe arms on Actions; physical scales only (vessels of a millimetre, fillets of tens of micrometres)

gate_1_composition_against_brute_force.claim: the seam-aware union's signed distance is exact within the band to the brute force's floor, at random rotations and sub-cell offsets (tilted and offset vessels), in both dtypes: under the band's contract line of 0.05 cells in the fluid and in the solid, with no unrefined and no unconverged point
gate_1_composition_against_brute_force.kind: bounds (the brute force is a sampled surface: it bounds the error from above by its floor plus the error)
gate_1_composition_against_brute_force.case: tests/scene/test_exact_union.py::test_the_union_is_exact_against_a_brute_force (TubeTree's lumen, its plan from the check at margin 0)

prediction.unit: cells, the largest |composed - brute| over the band, fluid and solid, per draw
prediction.why: the brute force at h/32 has a floor of about s/sqrt(2) = 0.022 cells next to the wall; the development checks read 0.013 to 0.020

gate_1_composition_against_brute_force.metric: max |composed - brute| in cells over the band: the band's contract is a line on exactly this

control.plant: the plain minimum in place of the composed distance (MIME_PLANT_UNION=minimum), 0.4 to 1.75 cells off in the fluid, far above the line
control.resolution: from discriminating_range.py: a planted error added at the failing points; predicted resolution about 0.035 to 0.05 cells (the line less the composed error on the draw)

gate_1_composition_against_brute_force.float32: the same line in float32; composed float32 against composed float64 within 1e-3 cells (predicted about 1e-4: Newton's floor at 4096 units in the last place of the point's scale is the acceptance, its reach far below)
gate_1_composition_against_brute_force.if_wrong: a draw over the line means the candidates miss a nearest point (Newton reaching another seam point, a corner not tried): the worst point's candidates are printed and the rule's completeness claim is withdrawn for that geometry
gate_1_composition_against_brute_force.cannot_discriminate_if: the band holds no failing point (no seam in the box): asserted against, each draw must hold failing points

gate_2_fillet_against_closed_form.claim: the fillet (the union's closing by a ball of radius r) is exact on both sides against closed forms: a wedge of two half-spaces (a straight seam) and two overlapping balls (a circular seam), at random orientations, openings, fillet radii and placements

prediction.unit: m, the largest |composed - closed form| in float64 at points within a few fillet radii of the seam, on a millimetre geometry
prediction.why: Newton converges to rounding (the half-spaces' seam in one step); 64 units in the last place of 1e-3 m is 1.4e-17 m, so a few hundred ulps

gate_2_fillet_against_closed_form.float32: within 1e-3 cells of h = 62.5 um (predicted about 1e-4 cells: a few hundred float32 ulps of 1e-3 m)
gate_2_fillet_against_closed_form.derivative: the fillet share's derivative against a central difference (float64) within 1e-6 of its scale

control.plant: the fillet dropped (the sharp union compared with the filleted closed form; MIME_PLANT_FILLET=dropped): off by about r (1/sin(w/2) - 1) near the seam, at least 1.5e-3 r at the widest drawn opening
control.resolution: from discriminating_range.py: the fillet's radius scaled by 1 + size; predicted resolution about 1e-9 relative (rounding over r)

gate_2_fillet_against_closed_form.if_wrong: an error above rounding on the solid side would refute the derivation that the closing is exact on both sides (the record said 'the solid side is unchecked')
gate_2_fillet_against_closed_form.cannot_discriminate_if: the drawn points all lie far from the seam (the fillet moves nothing there): points are drawn within three fillet radii of it

gate_3_junction_continuity.claim: the composed distance is continuous through the tree's junctions (the Y's and the loop's two), filleted and sharp, at random rotations: on dense lines through each junction no step between neighbouring samples exceeds their spacing (an exact signed distance is 1-Lipschitz)
gate_3_junction_continuity.kind: acceptance (a necessary property; exactness is gate 1's)

prediction.unit: the largest |step in distance| / spacing over the lines (plus rounding)
prediction.why: every candidate is a point of the boundary and the check's switch is continuous where a wall point reaches a seam

control.plant: the carina's seam left out of the candidates (MIME_PLANT_UNION=no-carina-seam), as a Newton that never converges there: the depth jumps where the check starts failing, by a share of the false wall (predicted 0.2 to 1 cell)
control.resolution: the line's slack is rounding; any jump above the spacing's rounding is caught

gate_3_junction_continuity.if_wrong: a jump means two candidates disagree where the rule switches between them: the switch's set is printed
gate_3_junction_continuity.cannot_discriminate_if: the lines miss the failing region: each line passes through the carina's neighbourhood by construction and the failing points along it are counted (at least one per line asserted)

gate_4_derivatives_implicit.claim: the distance's derivatives by implicit differentiation are exact where a seam or a corner is the nearest point: in the point, the fillet share, a daughter's radius and the junction's position, against central differences in float64
gate_4_derivatives_implicit.kind: equality to the difference's truncation and rounding

prediction.why: the development check read 3e-10 (share) and 1e-9 (radius) relative

control.plant: the implicit step left out (the seam's point held, MIME_PLANT_IMPLICIT=held): its derivative in the parameters loses the seam's motion
control.resolution: from discriminating_range.py: the tangent scaled by 1 + size; predicted resolution about 1e-6

gate_4_derivatives_implicit.if_wrong: a mismatch at a converged seam means the held Jacobian is not the KKT system's
gate_4_derivatives_implicit.cannot_discriminate_if: the drawn point's nearest candidate is the plain wall (no seam): the points are drawn among those whose selected candidate is a seam, and a draw whose differences straddle a switch (one-sided differences disagreeing) is non-discriminating, counted, never a pass
